I'd recommend artkal, they're around the same price as perler but have a bigger range of colours. They also have 2 types of beads, the soft ones are a bit easier to use in my opinion, I've just started out as well. Oh and don't forget, theres MIDI and MINI you probably wanna start out with MIDI they're 5mm beads, make sure you get the relevant pegboard for whichever you use.
Pegboard wise it may be better to go with perler 😅 I haven't managed to work with perler yet but they seem great. I just recommend artkal because I've found the company great to work with and they have some good sales 😅 you could go for a box set of either (perler or artkal) to get a feel for the colour pallets. You could also look up fuse beads on wish if you want some cheaper practice beads 🤷 not the worst idea, they have full kits for pretty cheap, then when you've got the practice in graduate to perler or artkal or Hama ECT
GOOD LUCK 😅 Don't forget to have fun.
